name: Billing Search Criteria 3
definition: Defines the criteria to be used to extract.

Service.name: Service
Service.definition: Identification of the service or system for which the billing information must be returned.

BillingPeriod.name: Billing Period
BillingPeriod.definition: General information for each invoice invoicing request or month end billing event is stored.

ResponsiblePartyIdentification.name: Responsible Party Identification
ResponsiblePartyIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the party responsible for the referenced party (that is, which has a contractual responsibility for the billed customer).

PartyIdentification.name: Party Identification
PartyIdentification.definition: Unique identification to unambiguously identify the billed party.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Either securities account or dedicated cash account number.
